programs.title: Mary J. Blige's Family Affair
programs.desc: Tensions rise between Kendra and Ben as they move out of the city and struggle with fertility issues. Their relationship reaches a boiling point when Ben secretly helps his brother, while Kendra returns to the city and reunites with an old friend.

programs.title: Chosen Family
programs.desc: Yoga teacher Ann cannot escape her manic family, miserable dating life, and inability to say no, leaving her constantly trying to fix everyone else's problems. Things start looking up, however, when her friends set her up with a divorced dad who has an adorable 7-year-old daughter.

programs.title: The Wandering Barber
programs.desc: Jeremy Regan believes places like his barber shop are public spaces of hallowed ground, to potentially understand the world better and even solve some of its biggest issues. As the barber/owner of Hunter and Gunn Barbershop in Winnipeg perhaps he is a bit biased. But to prove his theory, Jeremy hits the road, making his way to Ukraine in the midst of war to learn what local barbers are doing every day during the invasion to support those fending off the invaders. Along the way he uncovers the story of himself and the Ukrainian spirit.

programs.title: Home Free
programs.desc: Herb and Audrey have had a near perfect relationship for over fifty years. This anniversary Herb has a few surprises in store for his three estranged daughters. Herb, having recently been diagnosed with a fatal brain tumor, announces that he is choosing to die on his own terms and is not seeking treatment. As the daughters grapple with one another and wrestle their own demons, their father's condition worsens, and Audrey realizes that she's not ready to say goodbye to her true love.
